findings.description: Nicolas Uhres was born about 1856 in Keispelt, Luxembourg; the 1880 census of Kehlen commune enumerates him as single and gives that birth year and place.
supporting_sources: Luxembourg, Census Records, 1843-1900 — 1880 census entry for Nicolas Uhres, Kehlen, single, born 1856 in Keispelt (ark:/61903/1:1:6PBG-1Q63)

Luxembourg, Census Records, 1843-1900 — 1900 census household of Nicolas Uhres, Kehlen: wife Margreth Birgen/Birchen, children Jean (b. 1883 Keispelt) and Josephine (b. 1885 Keispelt), confirming identity with the tree's Johann and Josephine Uhres (ark:/61903/1:1:6BD5-5ZXB)
